high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the Washington Post. The post discusses the mysterious illness known as "Havana Syndrome," which first began affecting U.S. diplomats and intelligence officers in Havana, Cuba, in late 2016. The text describes the symptoms reported by victims, including headaches, nausea, memory loss, and other cognitive difficulties. It mentions that brain scans later showed tissue damage similar to that seen in patients with concussions after a bomb blast or car accident.
